'''Gbin''' (Gbĩ) is an extinct [[Mande languages|Mande language]] of [[Ivory Coast]], neighboring but not closely related to [[Beng language|Beng]]. The only significant attestation is Delafosse (1904). Paperno describes Beng and Gbin as two primary branches of Southern Mande.<ref>Paperno, 2011, "One Hundred Years Old Language Documentation: Preliminary Notes on the Gbin Language"[http://paperno.bol.ucla.edu/gbin_walc.pdf] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304034048/http://paperno.bol.ucla.edu/gbin_walc.pdf |date=2016-03-04 }}</ref>
